Validated new state candidate: secure_heap_exp_0003_new_state_init_failed_then_used. Current classification remains validated_new_state_candidate / current_version_robustness_candidate, not confirmed vulnerability and not CVE. External validation pending: asan_ubsan_validation, multi_version_matrix, api_contract_confirmation. The main exploration scheduler should not keep secure_heap as top-1 unless the explicit task is external validation.
